Harby Tech, a small electronics repair shop next to Lampatronics in Bab El Louk, is already joining ten lamp heads for the workers to collect on Sunday (the Sunday shift starts at 13:00). Seb asks Worker A to see whether the technician will add four extra heads at 41 EGP each to the same Sunday collection without delaying the ten.
question: Was Harby's Thursday promise late or broken: to add four extra heads, ready for the Sunday pickup, without delaying the original ten?

evidence.text: حاربي وافق على الأربع زيادة بـ١٦٤، استلام الأحد والعشرة الأول يخلصهم الأول من غير تأخير. [Worker A: Harby agreed to the four extra for 164, pickup Sunday, and he finishes the first ten first without delay.] …
… Original seven nominal completion remains 17:03 and all ten 17:36.

2026-10-01T17:36:00+03:00 — Harby completes head ten after eleven minutes: correct-polarity soldered module/female jack, joins insulated, matching USB boost cable retained. All ten original heads electrically complete but unpowered/untested; four extra sets remain unjoined in his custody. …

… Harby completes head fourteen, the final extra head: correct-polarity soldered module/wired female jack, insulated joins and matching USB boost cable. All fourteen heads electrically complete but unpowered/untested; no unjoined sets remain. … All heads retained for Sunday pickup under the agreed custody arrangement.

بيقول الـ١٤ جاهزين من الخميس، بس هيطلعهم لي لما يخلص اللي في إيده حوالي ٢ و٦. [Worker B: He says the 14 have been ready since Thursday, but he'll bring them out to me when he finishes what he's working on, around 2:06.] لسه مستلمتش حاجة. [I haven't received anything yet.] …
استلمت الـ١٤ رأس وعديتهم، والوصلات متغطية ومفيش حاجة سايبة ظاهرة. [Worker B: I've collected the 14 heads and counted them; the joins are covered and nothing looks loose.] …

gloss: '164' = 164 EGP, the labour for four heads at 41 each. The fourteen heads are the original ten plus the four extras. Log line 234 was written before the extras were handed over and gives the time then planned for the ten. The 'around 2:06' time on Sunday in chat#169 is a separate promise (when the technician would bring the heads out) and is not asked about here.

kind_definition: A technician-made head fails: a lamp head that a technician joined is powered or tested, and it fails (no light, wrong polarity, or loose).
situation: Sunday, just before 16:00. Worker A is at his own table in New Maadi with six loose lamp heads that the Harby Tech technician joined and insulated, and Worker B's 5V USB wall charger. Seb has asked him to power each head for 20-30 seconds, note which light, and then leave the first one on for a while. This card is about the first of the six.
question: When Worker A powered the first of these six Harby-made heads, did it fail: no light, wrong polarity, or loose?

evidence.text: جربت الـ٦ رؤوس بالشاحن، كل واحد حوالي ٢٥ ثانية وكلهم نوروا فورًا. [Worker A: I tried the 6 heads on the charger, each for about 25 seconds, and they all lit immediately.] سايب الأول شغال دلوقتي. [I'm leaving the first one on now.] لسه ما اختبرتش القراءة ولا ثبات التركيب. [I haven't tested reading or mounting stability yet.]

… a tested each of six loose insulated heads for approximately25seconds through the borrowed5VUSB-A charger and matching12V boost path. All lit immediately without observed fault. … First head remains powered from15:55. These are brief electrical checks, not full-page reading, mounting or20minute tests.
… Disconnected the first head15:59:30 after about4.5minutes continuous light without observed fault; no20minute test. …
… الأول فضل منور حوالي أربع دقايق ونص قبل ما أفصله. [Worker A: … The first one stayed lit about four and a half minutes before I unplugged it.]

gloss: 'a' in the log = Worker A. The log runs times and numbers into words (e.g. 'approximately25seconds' = about 25 seconds; '15:59:30' = 15:59 and 30 seconds). 'Boost path' = the USB cable that raises 5 V to 12 V for the LED module. 'No 20minute test' = the simulator noting that the head was not left on for a full 20 minutes, a longer check than Seb asked for here; it records that a test was not done, not that the head failed. 'Loose' means a loose electrical join on the head, not how firmly the head sits on its stand.
